## Resources

Over the years I've collected books, papers, tutorials, and tools that helped me grow as a researcher. These pages organize them and pass them on. They lean toward infectious disease modeling, epidemiological methods, and the practical side of academic life, and they're a work in progress. If you have suggestions, I'd love to hear from you.

[**Research practice**](research-practice.qmd)
: The "how" of doing science day to day: navigating AI tools thoughtfully, writing, giving talks, and staying organized.

[**Using AI in research**](ai-in-research.qmd)
: My personal, evolving guide to literature review and agentic coding workflows in computational epidemiology.

[**Methods reading list**](methods.qmd)
: Causal inference, Bayesian statistics, mathematical modeling, and coding.
